stemMd: The equation $a(2x+1)=6x+8$ has no solution. What is $a$?
explanationMd: No solution occurs when the x coefficients match but constants differ. Set 2a=6, so a=3; the equation becomes 6x+3=6x+8, an impossibility.

distractorRationale.a: This gives 0=6x+8, which has one solution.
distractorRationale.c: This leaves different x coefficients and therefore one solution.
distractorRationale.d: Matching a constant alone does not make the lines parallel.
